The '''Human-Qieg Guild''' was the ruling consortium of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]] and the [[Lan system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and was a stable alliance of [[Mine/Legends|mining]] guilds and companies. 

The Human-Qieg Guild became part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but under agreement with them was able to retain some independent while its mining operations were valued for taxation purposes. Representatives of the local [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] would arrive twice a year to remind the population of who was really in control.
